name: shelf-label
title: Shelf label
description: A retail shelf label: name, big price with raised cents, unit price and a scannable barcode, in black on white and printable at true size.
docs: Pass product, price in minor units, a barcode and, for goods sold by weight or volume, unitPrice as { amount, per }: '€2.49 per kg'. The barcode is an EAN-13, a UPC-A (12 digits) or an EAN-8 with its check digit, drawn as SVG with the digits under the bars the way the standard sets them; a wrong check digit is not drawn as a code, the label says what the digit should be. promotion puts a black strip across the top; detail adds a second line under the name. size is small (50 × 30 mm), medium (60 × 40 mm) or large (100 × 60 mm): on screen a label is drawn at about its printed size (the small ones a little larger, so their text stays readable) and everything inside is measured against the label itself, so it scales as one. The barcode takes the room the text above it leaves: a two-line name with a detail under a promotion makes it a little smaller instead of running into it, and the promotion stays on one line and is cut short with an ellipsis. The label is always black on white so it scans reliably, in the dark theme too. Mark labels printable and a print stylesheet takes everything else off the paper: each label prints at its true size in millimetres with its bars and strip, flowing down the page; the stylesheet uses :has(), which every current browser supports. The price is read out in full and drawn with its cents set small and raised. ean.ts holds the barcode arithmetic and runs on the server too. labels holds the three fixed phrases.
